svg.title: One workspace address, two process generations
svg.desc: Today, a Service can route the same address to replacement workspace B. A serving response alone does not show which process answered. Under the proposal, Compute pins the original workspace A before release, checks A's acknowledgement of the signed release and all four pins, then independently verifies A is serving. On each connection the Gateway verifies TLS with only the pinned CA before sending its bearer. The relay checks the bearer and released original before returning 101. The Gateway checks the generation proof before sending or accepting native frames. Missing or different proof closes the connection.
